title: Model quant defaults: automated heuristic selector and safety boundaries
creator: Aisha Raman
description:
Goal: Implement an automated per-model quantization selector that recommends an initial profile (FP8/INT8/FP16) and enforces safety boundaries via calibration and validation checks before a profile is promoted to the catalog. This ticket covers the selector heuristics, offline calibration workflow, the shadow validation harness, CI gating thresholds, and rollout/rollback rules for catalog defaults.

Motivation:
- Reduce manual effort when onboarding models to the catalog while preserving customer-facing quality.
- Provide deterministic fallbacks and explicit safety boundaries to avoid silent accuracy regressions after quant changes.
- Streamline observability and tracing for quant-induced regressions so SRE/ML teams can act fast.

Scope / Deliverables:
1) Heuristic selector service that ingests model metadata (architecture, param count, tokenization, activation distributions from sample traces) and recommends a ranked set of quant profiles (FP8 mixed, symmetric INT8, per-channel INT8, FP16 fallback) with confidence estimates.
2) Offline calibration pipeline: sample selection rules (dataset fingerprinting and shard-aware sampling), calibration routine (min/max/percentile-based for activations and weight ranges), and an artifacts store (calibration signatures + metadata).
3) Shadow validation harness: run generation + embedding parity tests using curated test suites and customer-simulated prompt sets; compute stability metrics and semantic-similarity thresholds.
4) CI gating: automated gating job that enforces numerical/semantic tolerances (per-token perplexity delta, mean embedding cosine similarity, answer-level exact/ROUGE thresholds) before a recommended profile is marked as safe.
5) Catalog autoflag and rollout plan: how a recommended profile moves from candidate -> canary -> staged -> default, with explicit rollback triggers and telemetry alerts.
6) Documentation and console UX hooks: metadata fields in the catalog UI for recommended profile reason, confidence band, and a link to calibration artifacts and validation dashboards.

Non-goals:
- New kernel implementations or low-level execution changes (this ticket integrates with existing runtime kernels).
- Full end-to-end per-customer A/B experiments (we will surface hooks but leave customer-specific rollouts to a follow-up).
acceptance_criteria:
1) Heuristic selector returns a ranked list of 3 quant profile suggestions for each model in the onboarding testbed with confidence scores and a textual justification.
2) Calibration pipeline produces reproducible calibration signatures stored in artifacts bucket and a compact summary JSON per-run.
3) Shadow validation jobs report numeric and semantic metrics; candidate profiles that pass CI gating must not regress: token-level avg perplexity delta <= 2.0% and mean embedding cosine similarity >= 0.985 on the CanonicalTestSet.
4) Console shows the recommended profile, its confidence, and link to calibration + validation artifacts.
5) Runbook for rollback and canary metrics written and reviewed.
6) Unit/integration tests for selector logic and CI gating jobs added to pipeline and green in CI.

runbook:
Calibration artifacts -> validate locally with harness `quant-validate` which runs:
- numeric parity (per-token perplexity and logprob distributions)
- semantic parity (embedding cosine + answer similarity)
- performance smoke (latency, GPU memory).
Rollback triggers: any CI gating failure, semantic similarity drop > 1.5% on Canary, or latency regression > 20%.
notes: This ticket targets decoder-only and encoder-decoder families separately; selector model will be trained with cross-architecture folds. Coordinate with research for large-scale evaluation later. Ensure artifacts are tagged with model hash and seed for reproducibility.
